anatomyReview.supports: Later-reference mitral and tricuspid leaflets have unequal shapes and branching chordal attachments. The tricuspid example has a larger anterior, shorter posterior and distinct septal leaflet. Semilunar cusps retain pockets, sinus walls and removable aortic tissue layers.
anatomyReview.limitations: Isolated partly open teaching stations, not measured stage-specific anatomy. Dimensions, chordal counts and a three-scallop posterior example are illustrative; leaflet variants occur. Planar annular support, aortomitral continuity, coronary ostia, early cushions and direct septal chordal support remain incomplete.
